examName: MAHARASHTRA PUBLIC SERVICE COMMISSION - Dental Surgeon (Group -B) Screening Test
examNameMr: महाराष्ट्र लोकसेवा आयोग - दंत शल्यचिकित्सक (गट-ब) चाळणी परीक्षा

papers.paperTitleMr: दंत शल्यचिकित्सक (गट-ब) पदाच्या भरतीसाठी चाळणी परीक्षा

units.unitTitle: Anatomy, Physiology, Biochemistry, Pathology, Microbiology, Pharmacology, Medicine and Surgery as applied to dentistry
units.unitTitleMr: दंतचिकित्सेशी संबंधित शरीररचनाशास्त्र, शरीरक्रियाशास्त्र, जैव रसायनशास्त्र, विकृतिशास्त्र, जंतूशास्त्र, औषधशास्त्र, वैद्यकशास्त्र आणि शल्यचिकित्साशास्त्र
topics: Anatomy - Muscles of mastication, T.M.J., Tongue and Oral mucosa, Salivary Glands, Dental Morphology
Physiology & Biochemistry - Blood, Bone, Functions of Saliva
Pathology and Microbiology - Inflammations and Infections, Neoplasias, Degeneration, Sterilization procedures, aseptic techniques & disinfections, Pathogenic organisms of common occurrence
Pharmacology - Anaesthetics, Analgesics, Antibiotics, Pharmacotherapy of common oral conditions
Various aspects of Surgical Principles as related to Orodental diseases
Endodontics - various endodontic procedures including emergency procedures
Pulpal and Periapical diseases and their management
General considerations of traumatic injuries of the Jaws
Surgical Management of common oral conditions such as cysts, tumours, infections etc.
Materials used in the construction of various orthodontic appliances
Behaviour Management & various preventive treatment modalities in a child patient
Dental care of children with special needs
Dental emergencies in children and their management
Special emphasis on Pit & fissure sealants & fluorides
Various Gingival & Periodontal diseases & their etiology & management
Diagnosis, Indications, Fabrication, Delivery & post operative follow up in Partial Denture, Complete Denture & fixed prosthesis patients
Environmental health with emphasis on waste disposal
Practice management & maintenance of records, dead stock, accounts and audit
A brief introduction to various implant systems in practice
Examination of dental evidence with proper evaluation & presentation of dental findings
WHO declarations and DCI code of ethics
Recent advances and modern techniques in dental practice

importantNotes: Emphasis will be given to the clinical aspects of each subject encountered in day-to-day dental practice.
